prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a pixel-art 2x2 expression atlas for Tianyi on an embedded companion display.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the existing pixel-art atlas. Input image 2 is a HAIRSTYLE SHAPE REFERENCE supplied by the user. Follow image 2's actual hair silhouette closely; do not follow the inaccurate hair loops in image 1.

Primary edit: replace the SINGLE centered loop of hair sticking up from the crown in image 1 with EXACTLY TWO LARGE SIDE-BY-SIDE ARCHING HAIR LOOPS on the TOP of the crown, like the two lobes of a sideways figure-eight / bow. One large hollow arch rises from the left crown and returns toward the center; the matching arch rises from the right crown and returns toward the center. They meet near the center of the crown, just as in image 2. These two crown loops must be clearly separated by visible dark background inside each opening and occupy the existing top hair margin without moving the eyes or face down.
Rework the side hair to match image 2: smooth grey locks curve down from behind each ear and turn inward to join at a bow near the jaw/neck, then continue as hanging tails. Keep the large elongated open return curve beside each cheek where visible. Remove the small round plaited buns beside the upper temples; the two unmistakable big loops belong on TOP of the head. Do not create bead-like stacks of tiny rings at the temples or by the ears. No lone central ahoge or third top loop.
Preserve image 1's pixel-art rendering, silver-grey hair color, bright green eyes, face position, bangs over the forehead, tiny headset microphone, turquoise music-note hair clip, white-and-turquoise outfit, friendly expression and flat dark navy-teal background. The reference image controls hair GEOMETRY only, not illustration style, camera angle, white background, face or clothes.
Output a square perfectly regular 2x2 atlas of four equal tiles, no gutters/borders/text. Maintain EXACT face alignment across all tiles and the same corrected hair in every tile. Top-left open eyes/closed smile, top-right blink/closed smile, bottom-left open eyes/small speaking mouth, bottom-right open eyes/wider speaking mouth. Only eye/mouth pixels differ.
Crisp chunky native 64x64 logical-pixel clusters per tile, enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor edges. The two large crown loops must remain distinct after reduction to 64x64. No smooth anime painting, anti-aliasing, gradients, text or watermark.
